content: Sosep Kawehwehda sapwellimen Parao Eliman kan
Mwurin sounpar riau, Parao ahpw ketin elimanda me dene e ketiket ni keilen Pillap Nail,
ni ahnsowo kou kaselel mworourou isimen ahpw pwarada sang nan pillapo oh tapihada mwengemwenge ni keilen pillapo.
Mwuhr, pil kou isimen pwarada sang nan pillapo; re me inenen tihti oh mwomw suwed. Re kohda oh pil iang mihmi limwahn kou teiko,
oh kou tihti ko uhdahte kangala kou mworourou ko. Parao eri ohpala wasa.
E ahpw pil seimwokla oh pwurehng elimanda. Wahn kohn isuh uhsang ni kirikirtehpwoat; re inenen kaneng oh kaselel.
A pil wahn kohn isuh pil wosada me sohte kanenge oh meng pwehki kisinieng en nan sapwtehn,
re ahpw kangala wahn kohn isuh kaneng oh kaselel ko. Parao eri ohpala wasa, oh ketin diarada me e ketin eliman.
Nimenseng e ahpw kupwur toutoula, e ahpw kapokonepene sounakmanaman oh me loalokong kan koaros en Isip. Ih eri mahsanihong irail duwen sapwellime eliman ko; ahpw sohte emen rehrail me kak kawehwehda.
Sapwellime sounkohwahn waino ahpw patohwanohng Parao, “Rahnwet I pahn sakarkihda sapwung me I wiadahr.
Ni omwi ketin engiengda pahi oh kaunen wie pilawao, komwi ahpw ketikihong kiht nan imweteng nan imwen kaunen silasil ko.
Se ahpw patohwan ouramanda pwohng ehu. Kiht koaros ouraman ahpw wehwehpara wekpeseng.
Mwahnakapw en Ipru men iang kiht mihmi nan imwetengo, lidun kaunen pwihnen silasil. Kiht eri padahkihong duwen at ouraman ko. E ahpw kawehwehiong kiht.
Soahng koaros eri pweida duwen me e kawehwedahr ko: ngehi eri pwurehng nan dewei, a soun wie pilawao langadahng nin tuhkeo.”
Parao eri poaronelahng Sosep en patohdo reh. Re ahpw mwadangete kihieisang nan imwetengo, oh mwurin eh kihsang eh alis ko, oh wilian eh likou kan, Sosep ahpw patohla pahn kupwur en Parao.
Parao eri mahsanihong, “Ahi ouraman ehu, ahpw sohte mehmen me kak kawehwehda. I rong me dene ke kak kawehwehda ouraman.”
Sosep eri patohwan sapeng, “I sohte kak, ahpw Koht me pahn ketin kupwurkalahngan kawehwehiong komwi.”
Parao ahpw mahsanih, “I ouraman me I kesikesihnen ni keilen Pillap Nail,
a kou mworourou kaselel isimen ahpw pwarada sang nan pillapo oh tapihada mwengemwengeseli.
Mwuhr, pil kou isimen pwarada sang nan pillapo, me inenen tihti oh mwomw suwed. I saikinte mwahn kilangada soangen kou sakanakan duwehte met kan nan Isip pwon.
Eri, kou tihti ko ahpw kangala kou mworourou ko,
ahpw sohte sansal lipwen ar kangala, pwe re mwomwomw suwedte oh wie tihtihte duwehte mahs. Ngehi eri pirada.
I pil pwurehng ouraman, dene I kilangada wahn kohn isuh, me inenen kaneng oh kaselel, me uhsang ni kirikirtehpwoat.
Mwuhr, pil wahn kohn isuh ahpw pil wosada, me sohte kanenge oh meng pwehki kisinieng en nan sapwtehn,
re ahpw kangala wahn kohn kaselel ko. Eri, I padahkihongehr sounakmanaman akan ouraman pwukat, ahpw sohte emen rehrail me kak kawehwehiong ie.”
Sosep ahpw patohwanohng Parao, “Sapwellimomwi eliman riau wet wehwehteieu. Koht kupwurki kasalehiong komwi dahme e pahn ketin wia.
Eri, kou mworourou isimen ko wehwehki sounpar isuh, oh kohn kaneng isuh ko pil wehwehki sounpar isuh; koaros wehwehteieu.
A kou tihti isimen ko me kohda mwuhr oh kohn sohte kanenge ko me mengkihla kisinieng en nan sapwtehn, wehwehki sounpar isuhwen lehk lapalap.
Ih pahn duwen me I patohwanohngkomwier—Koht ketin kasalehiongkomwier dahme e pahn ketin wia.
Sounpar isuh rahk laplap pahn mie nan Isip pwon.
Mwurin sounpar isuh lehk lapalap pil pahn usehla, oh sohla me pahn tamatamanki ahnsoun rahko, pwehki lehk lapalapo pahn kauwehla wehiet.
Aramas akan pahn manokehla rahk lapalapo, pwehki lehk lapalap me pahn wiawi mwuri pahn mwuledek.
Kahrepen omwi eliman pak riau pwehki Koht ketin kileledier me irair wet pahn pweida ni ahnsou keren.
“Eri, met komw pahn ketin rapahkihda ohl loalokong oh koahiek men me komw pahn ketikihong doadoahk en apwahpwalih wehiet.
Komw pahn pil ketin kilelehdi ekei lapalap me pahn nekidala limakis ehun wahnsahpw erein sounpar isuhwen rahk.
Padahkihong irail re en nahkpene wahnsahpw koaros erein ahnsoun rahk me pahn kohdo, oh kihong irail manaman en nekidala oh sile pilawa kan nan kahnimw kan.
Pwe tohn wehi pokon en kak kang ni ahnsou me lehk lapalap pahn kohdo nan Isip. Pwe aramas akan en dehr duhpekla.”
Sosep Kesepwilda wiahla Kepina en Isip
Parao oh sapwellime lapalap akan ahpw kamanahla koasoandi wet.
Parao eri mahsanihong irail, “Kitail sohte kak diar emen ohl me duwehte Sosep, me audaukidahr ngehn en Koht.”
Parao eri mahsanihong Sosep, “Koht ketin kasalehiongkomwiher mepwukat koaros, eri e dehde mehlel me sohte emen ohl me loalokong oh koahiek sang komwi.
Eri, met I pahn kasapwilkomwihda, pwe komwi en kaunda ei wehi, oh nei aramas akan koaros pahn kin kapwaiada omwi koasoandi. Ngehite me pahn lapalapasang komwi.
Met I kasapwiladahngkomwiher en wiahla kepina en Isip pwon.”
Parao eri ketikihsang sapwellime kisin rihng en nanmwarki oh ketikihong ni sendin pehn Sosep. E ahpw pil ketin kalikawihkihda likou linen kaselel, oh ketin kammwarehkihda elin kohl ehu.

E ahpw ketikihong sapwellime werennansapw keriau pwe en dake, oh sapwellime pwihnen sounpei ahpw tieng mwowe, pakapakairki ni ngihl laud, ndinda, “Kumwail poaridiong! Kumwail poaridiong!” Ih duwen Sosep eh wiahla kaunen Isip pwon.
Parao ahpw mahsanihong Sosep, “Ngehi me nanmwarki, ahpw sohte emen nan Isip pwon pahn kamwakid peh de neh, ma komw sohte pahn mweidohng.”

E ahpw ketikidahng pohn Sosep mwar ehu, iei, Sapenat Panea; oh ketikihong eh pwoud, Asenat, nein Podipera serepein; Podipera me samworo en kahnimw Iliopolis. Sosep sounpar 30 ahnsou me eh tapihada papah Parao, nanmwarkien Isip. E ahpw seiloak kapilseli Isip pwon.
Erein sounpar isuhwen rahko, wahnsahpwo inenen pweida mwahu,
Sosep eri kihpene kisin mwenge koaros oh nahkpene nan kahnimw kan. Nan ehuehu kahnimw kan e kin kihpene mwengehn wasa kan me karanih kahnimwo.
E kihpene wahn pilawa me uwe rasehng pihken ni oaroahr kan; e ahpw sohla sohng, pwehki eh sohla kak sosohng.
Eri, mwohn sounpar en lehk lapalap ko leledo, Asenat ahpw naitikihong Sosep pwutak riemen.
Sosep eri patohwan, “Koht me ketin kupwurehda pwe I en manokehla douluhl ei lokolok koaros oh peneineien ei pahpao”; ih eri kihong eden nah meseniho, Manase.
E ahpw pil patohwan, “Koht me ketikihong ie wahnedi kan nan sapwen ei apwal kan”; ih eri kihong eden nah pwutak keriemeno, Epraim.
Sounpar isuhwen rahk nan Isip eri imwisekla,
a sounpar isuhwen lehk lapalap ahpw uhd tepida, duwen Sosep eh kohpadahr. Lehk lapalap kipehdi wehi teikan koaros, ahpw nan Isip mie kisin mwenge.
Ahpw ni ahnsou me mehn Isip ko kin men mwenge, re kin patohla peki kisin mwenge rehn Parao. Ih eri kin mahsanihong irail re en kohla rehn Sosep oh wia dahme e pahn patohwanohng irail.
Ni lehk lapalapo eh uklahr oh kipehdi wasa koaros nan wehio pwon, Sosep ahpw ritingada imwen nahk koaros oh netikihong mehn Isip ko pilawa ko.
Sang wasa koaros nin sampah, aramas akan kin pwarodo rehn Sosep pwe re en pwainda arail tungoal pilawa, pwe lehk lapalapo pil lelpeseng wasa koaros.
